verdict.rationale: Viam documents logic modules for background automation: they react to sensor data, coordinate components, run continuous processes, and schedule actions. Inline modules handle build and deployment from the browser, and machines keep running on cached configs during connectivity loss (corroborated by a community report). Missing for 10: detailed docs on scheduling and triggers beyond brief mentions, any no-code or declarative automation setup (automations require writing code), and independent hands-on confirmation of logic modules running autonomously.
